channel.title: Kubernetes on DAWN's Blog
channel.description: Recent content in Kubernetes on DAWN's Blog

item.title: K8S Security Framework and RBAC in Action: Fine-Grained User & Group Access Control with CFSSL Certificates
item.description: A comprehensive guide to the Kubernetes security framework (Authentication, Authorization, Admission Control) and RBAC core model: hands-on demonstration of issuing certificates for Users and Groups using CFSSL, scripting kubeconfig generation, and configuring Role/ClusterRole bindings with boundary validation.

item.title: K8S Node Lifecycle and Cluster Shrinking in Action: Graceful Pod Eviction with Cordon/Drain and Node Decommissioning
item.description: A comprehensive walkthrough of graceful node shrinking and decommissioning in production Kubernetes clusters. Covers workload eviction using kubectl drain and cordon with DaemonSet filtering, unschedulable taints, uncordon node recovery, as well as destructive node decommission steps including kubelet stoppage, kubeadm reset environment clearing, disk wiping, and node deletion from master.

item.title: K8S AutoScaling in Action: Metrics-Server Aggregation Deployment and HPA Stress-Testing Demystified
item.description: An end-to-end guide to establishing resource metric monitoring and horizontal autoscaling in Kubernetes: from production-ready adaptation of the official metrics-server manifest (secure ports, self-signed TLS certs, scrape interval tuning) and kubectl top verification, to simulating high CPU load with stress, analyzing dynamic HPA scale-out (2→6→10 replicas) and cooldown scale-in, covering both CLI and autoscaling/v2 declarative YAML.

item.title: K8S Pod Scheduling in Action: Direct Scheduling, Node/Pod Affinities, and Taints & Tolerations Demystified
item.description: An in-depth guide to Kubernetes Pod scheduling strategies and underlying mechanics: covering nodeName scheduler bypass and network port collision troubleshooting, comprehensive testing of Taints (NoSchedule/PreferNoSchedule/NoExecute) with exact and wildcard tolerations, NodeAffinity hard/soft constraints with weight fallback, and hands-on PodAffinity co-location alongside PodAntiAffinity cross-topology mutual exclusion.

item.title: K8S Workloads in Action: Deep Dive into Job, CronJob, and DaemonSet with MySQL Backup & Restore Practice
item.description: An in-depth exploration of batch processing and daemon workloads in Kubernetes: from the backoffLimit retry mechanism of Pi calculation Jobs, to hands-on multi-database backup and cross-environment restore using Jobs with dual NFS volumes, followed by CronJob scheduling validation and DaemonSet node taint troubleshooting.

item.title: K8S Pod RestartPolicy in Action: Always, OnFailure, Never Behaviors, Exit Code Handling, and CrashLoopBackOff Demystified
item.description: An in-depth hands-on test of Kubernetes Pod restart policies (Always, OnFailure, Never): simulating exit code 137 terminations via docker kill and normal process completions (exit code 0). Deeply analyzes container replacement, pause container lifecycle, K8S RESTARTS counters, CrashLoopBackOff backoff mechanisms, and verifies the default Always behavior.

item.title: K8S External Service Integration Practice: Manual Endpoints Mapping External MySQL with WordPress End-to-End Linkage
item.description: A hands-on guide to integrating external stateful services into Kubernetes: using a selector-less Service paired with manual Endpoints to integrate a standalone host MySQL instance into the cluster, deploying a 3-replica WordPress with dynamic Host injection to fix NodePort access, and verifying full end-to-end read/write workflows from MetalLB to the external database.

item.title: K8S Static Pod Lifecycle in Practice: From kubeadm Bootstrap Principles to Control Plane Fault Drills
item.description: A deep dive into the Kubernetes Static Pod working mechanism and kubelet daemon logic, uncovering how kubeadm bootstraps the four core control plane components, hands-on custom static Pod self-healing verification, and control plane apiserver fault injection and recovery drills.

item.title: K8S Service Types and External Traffic Access: MetalLB Practice, Endpoints Mapping, and NodePort Range Customization
item.description: A comprehensive overview of Kubernetes four Service types and use cases, hands-on practice deploying MetalLB in on-premise clusters for LoadBalancer virtual IPs and fixed NodePorts, comparison between ExternalName and manual Endpoints for routing external services, and customizing apiserver static Pod parameters to extend the NodePort port range.

item.title: K8S Service Proxy Mode in Practice: Deep Dive from iptables Three-Tier Chains to Kernel IPVS Tuning
item.description: A deep dive into Kubernetes Service underlying traffic forwarding mechanisms, comparing the performance differences between iptables and IPVS, deconstructing the iptables three-tier chain probabilistic traffic distribution using kube-dns, and providing a complete hands-on guide to switching kube-proxy to IPVS mode in production.

item.title: K8S Resource Quota Management Practice: Deep Dive into ResourceQuota and LimitRange Constraints
item.description: A deep dive into Kubernetes resource constraint mechanisms including Pod resources (requests/limits), namespace-level ResourceQuota, and container-level LimitRange, with hands-on validation using stress testing, compute quotas, and object count limits.

item.title: K8S and Jenkins CI/CD Practice: Harbor Integration, Parameterized Builds, and One-Click Rollback
item.description: A complete end-to-end CI/CD pipeline practice using Kubernetes and Jenkins: covering Jenkins offline installation, Docker and self-signed Harbor TLS certificate integration, kubectl cluster authorization, Freestyle jobs, string/choice/Git tag parameterized builds, and Kubernetes Deployment rolling updates with one-click rollbacks.

item.title: K8S ReplicaSet and Deployment Controllers in Practice: Replica Control, Rolling Updates, and Rollback Mechanisms
item.description: An in-depth hands-on guide to Kubernetes ReplicaSet and Deployment controllers, covering matchLabels and matchExpressions label selectors (Pod adoption mechanism), Recreate and RollingUpdate deployment strategies (detailed analysis of maxSurge and maxUnavailable), and declarative/imperative rollout management with multi-version rollbacks.

item.title: Kubernetes Blue-Green and Canary Deployment in Practice: Comparison of Three Deployment Strategies
item.description: In-depth comparison of Blue-Green deployment, Canary release, and A/B testing in Kubernetes. Step-by-step hands-on guide demonstrating instant zero-downtime traffic switching via dual ReplicationControllers and Service label selector swapping (apps: xiuxian -> apps: green), as well as phased progressive traffic shifting via dual-label design (business label school: czu and version label apps: v1/v2) and replica scaling.

item.title: Manually Deploying a Kubernetes v1.30 Cluster (via kubeadm)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to manually deploying a Kubernetes v1.30 cluster with kubeadm — covering firewall/SELinux, swap, kernel modules, Containerd, kubeadm init, worker join, Calico, and an IPVS add-on.
